# Kibby

> Kibby is a cosy word guessing game where players try to find the hidden word one guess at a time.

Kibby is a browser-based word guessing game with a cosy, underwater visual style featuring an axolotl mascot and marine/coral artwork.

The website has two main pages:

## Pages

- [Kibby](https://play-kibby.com/): The main landing page for Kibby, introducing the game.
- [Play Kibby](https://play-kibby.com/play): The interactive word guessing game.

## Game

- Kibby is a word guessing game.
- The game is played directly in the browser.
- The game interface includes a word grid, an on-screen keyboard, a hint action, and controls for changing the game.
- The interface supports an AZERTY keyboard layout.
